mechanism: Both drugs increase CNS depression and serotonergic activity; atomoxetine inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes hydrocodone to its active form, potentially reducing hydrocodone efficacy while increasing parent drug levels.
action: Monitor closely for enhanced CNS depression, respiratory depression, and serotonin syndrome; consider alternative analgesic or ADHD medication; if co-prescribed, use lowest effective doses with reduced dosing intervals.
